title: Benchmarking Segmentation Models for Scalable Mangrove Mapping with Sentinel-1/2 Imagery
abstract: arXiv:2611.33369v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mangroves are dynamic coastal ecosystems that contribute to carbon storage, coastal protection and biodiversity conservation, but are vulnerable to climate change. Very-high-resolution imagery such as Pl\'eiades enables detailed mangrove mapping but it is costly and have a low revisit rate. Large-scale monitoring requires free and regularly available data such as Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 but their spatial resolution poses challenges for detailed mangrove mapping. In this work, we benchmark deep learning approaches for mangrove mapping from Sentinel-1 radar and Sentinel-2 optical imagery using reference maps derived from very-high-resolution Pl\'eiades imagery. We compare four segmentation configurations based on CROMA and BigEarthNet-pretrained ResNet50 representations with different segmentation decoders. translated_title: 基于Sentinel-1/2影像的可扩展红树林制图分割模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 红树林是动态的沿海生态系统，在碳储存、海岸保护和生物多样性保护方面发挥着重要作用，但同时易受气候变化影响。诸如Pléiades等极高分辨率影像能够实现精细的红树林制图，但成本高昂且重访频率低。大规模监测需要免费且可定期获取的数据，例如Sentinel-1和Sentinel-2，但其空间分辨率给精细的红树林制图带来了挑战。在这项工作中，我们使用从极高分辨率Pléiades影像衍生的参考图，对基于Sentinel-1雷达和Sentinel-2光学影像进行红树林制图的深度学习方法进行了基准测试。我们比较了基于CROMA和BigEarthNet预训练ResNet50表征并采用不同分割解码器的四种分割配置。我们构建了一个覆盖法属圭亚那、苏里南和阿马帕州的红树林制图数据集。CROMA + UPerNet取得了最佳性能。
tldr: 该论文构建了一个覆盖法属圭亚那、苏里南和阿马帕州的红树林制图数据集，对基于Sentinel-1/2影像和不同预训练表征与分割解码器的深度学习模型进行了基准测试，发现CROMA + UPerNet组合在可扩展的大规模红树林制图中表现最佳。
